description: I’m Ramzy, a Master’s student in AI/bioinformatics at USTHB, Algiers. During my ASAL research internship I worked on Sentinel-2 forest/built-up classification, satellite super-resolution (Real-ESRGAN vs Stable Diffusion) and gesture recognition for touchless control. I also built an asteroid tracker with NASA’s NeoWs API. Looking for a front-end/UI dev, a space/Earth observation enthusiast and a designer for the demo. Beginners welcome. We’ll aim for a working prototype.
